item.title: Interior project designer
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Applicants must have first-hand experience in preparing details, specifications, and construction documents. Strong working knowledge of current versions of AutoCAD, Revit, 3D Studio Max, Sketch-up, Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign, and Microsoft Office Suite are essential. Must have prior experience working on active construction sites on a multitude of project types. Expertise in AutoCAD, Revit and MS Office is mandatory. A Master’s degree in Architecture is required from an accredited school that will allow for Intern status with the Ontario Association of Architects. Candidates should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, be self-driven, and must have an interest in working collaboratively to produce high end results for our clients.

Preferred Considerations:
  • Ability to prepare Architectural presentation documents (renderings, boards, booklets, etc);
  • Understanding of Adobe products including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign;
  • Understanding of Rhino, Grasshopper, and parametric design;
  • LEED BD+C Accreditation.
Duties:

The successful candidate will be required to perform the following:

  • Ability to prepare Architectural presentation documents (renderings, boards, booklets, etc);
  • Understanding of Adobe products including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign;
  • Understanding of Rhino, Grasshopper, and parametric design;
  • LEED BD+C Accreditation.

item.title: Summer house
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Modern fantasy
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Penthouse 501
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Villa Neron
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Villa skyfall
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: GG Art Gallery
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Holis Passive House
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Bawly Modern House
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Industrial Luxury Style, explained by Minnaro Design
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

item.title: 2025 Design Awards Recap
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

item.title: How a Minnaro became a model for affordable, sustainable living
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

Function with Style","header_size":"h3"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"699c0a0e","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn\u2019t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it\u2019s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that\u2019s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharn\u00e9 provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client\u2019s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents\u2014 oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.<\/p>","text_columns":"1","_margin":{"unit":"em","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"-1.5","left":"0","isLinked":false},"_margin_tablet":{"unit":"em","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"-1","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=f87c010","drop_cap_primary_color":"globals\/colors?id=vamtam_accent_2","drop_cap_typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=621b64a"},"_margin_mobile":{"unit":"em","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":true}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Kaave Academy
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Heise
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. item.title: Casa Palermo
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Contemporary Chair
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Project Architect
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Applicants must have first-hand experience in preparing details, specifications, and construction documents. Strong working knowledge of current versions of AutoCAD, Revit, 3D Studio Max, Sketch-up, Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign, and Microsoft Office Suite are essential. Must have prior experience working on active construction sites on a multitude of project types. Expertise in AutoCAD, Revit and MS Office is mandatory. A Master’s degree in Architecture is required from an accredited school that will allow for Intern status with the Ontario Association of Architects. Candidates should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, be self-driven, and must have an interest in working collaboratively to produce high end results for our clients.

Preferred Considerations:
  • Ability to prepare Architectural presentation documents (renderings, boards, booklets, etc);
  • Understanding of Adobe products including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign;
  • Understanding of Rhino, Grasshopper, and parametric design;
  • LEED BD+C Accreditation.
Duties:

The successful candidate will be required to perform the following:

  • Ability to prepare Architectural presentation documents (renderings, boards, booklets, etc);
  • Understanding of Adobe products including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign;
  • Understanding of Rhino, Grasshopper, and parametric design;
  • LEED BD+C Accreditation.

item.title: Grand Terra
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Tower
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year
2024

Location

New York

Type

Residential

Area

2814 Sq Ft

Services

Construction
Interior design
Bespoke furnishings



A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes




Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Somersby villa
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Rolling apartment
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Station house
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Quebec mountain view
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: The NY apartment
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Hilton forest colonial
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: From mood to matter
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

item.title: The beauty of restraint
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents— oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn\u2019t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren\u2019t just for show; they solved things.<\/p>","text_columns":"1","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=f87c010","drop_cap_primary_color":"globals\/colors?id=vamtam_accent_2","drop_cap_typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=621b64a"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"848aba9","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design","header_size":"h3"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"1c84c0b","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose\u2014nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it\u2019s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction\u2014dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.<\/p>

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.<\/p>","text_columns":"1","_margin":{"unit":"rem","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":false},"_margin_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=f87c010","drop_cap_primary_color":"globals\/colors?id=vamtam_accent_2","drop_cap_typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=621b64a"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false},{"id":"89dcb78","elType":"container","settings":{"flex_direction":"row","boxed_width":{"unit":"px","size":1120,"sizes":[]},"padding":{"unit":"%","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":true},"_title":"Images","flex_gap":{"column":"30","row":"30","isLinked":true,"unit":"px","size":30},"padding_tablet":{"unit":"%","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":true},"padding_mobile":{"unit":"%","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":true},"flex_gap_tablet":{"column":"20","row":"20","isLinked":true,"unit":"px","size":20},"margin":{"unit":"custom","top":"calc(6vh - Function with Style","header_size":"h3"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"87eb936","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn\u2019t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it\u2019s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that\u2019s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharn\u00e9 provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client\u2019s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically. Ultimately, the chosen scheme found its strength in grounded accents\u2014 oversized artwork, sculptural side tables, and a mix of tactile finishes that feel both current and low-pressure.<\/p>","text_columns":"1","_margin":{"unit":"em","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"-1.5","left":"0","isLinked":false},"_margin_tablet":{"unit":"em","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"-1","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=f87c010","drop_cap_primary_color":"globals\/colors?id=vamtam_accent_2","drop_cap_typography_typography":"globals\/typography?id=621b64a"},"_margin_mobile":{"unit":"em","top":"","right":"","bottom":"","left":"","isLinked":true}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}]

Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Casa 201
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Welington house
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Villa Rossa
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Year 2024
Location
New York
Type
Residential
Area
2814 Sq Ft
Services
Construction Interior design Bespoke furnishings

A charming four-storey summer house in New York, thoughtfully designed for a young family of four

The brief

This four-storey Victorian townhouse in the heart of New York is home to a young family of four. The design celebrates the property’s rich period character, enhancing its original features with thoughtful, timeless updates. Highlights include a classic Shaker kitchen, a striking entrance hallway (perhaps our favourite to date!), inviting reception rooms layered with pattern and warmth, and a luxurious master suite with a roll-top bath and walk-in shower. The top floor houses two enchanting children’s bedrooms.

Each level tells its story, blending Victorian charm with modern comforts to reflect the family’s unique style and spirit: a truly magical home—and a joy to bring to life.

Scope of Work

Complete design concept, mood boards, floor plans, and joinery drawings. Furniture and fixture sourcing. Renovation completed by Son & Son in collaboration with our trusted trades and partners.

PHOTO CREDIT

Carmen Lopes

Natural textures, such as wood, stone, and woven materials, combined with rich, deep blue tones, create a harmonious flow that seamlessly connects the various spaces throughout the home. This thoughtful combination not only enhances visual continuity but also evokes a sense of calm and cohesion, making each room feel like an intentional extension of the next.

item.title: Building and the future of clean energy
item.dc:creator: vamtam
item.content:encoded:
Looking to create a bedroom that feels like a peaceful retreat? This recent transformation showcases how a relaxing bedroom design can turn any space into a serene sanctuary. With calming colors, cozy textures, and thoughtful touches, this bedroom became the ultimate place for rest and relaxation.

The result is a space that invites rest, promotes relaxation, and provides a much-needed escape from the hustle of daily life. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing your current setup, this design demonstrates how small changes can significantly impact your well-being and comfort.

The Challenge: Relaxing Bedroom Design Ideas

The client turned to Minnaro with a clear goal: to transform a portion of their home into a space that felt more serene, inviting, and livable. Their focus was on the bedroom—a personal retreat that needed a fresh, contemporary design. They envisioned a relaxing and neutral atmosphere, one that would promote rest and tranquility without requiring major structural renovations.

Except the existing doors and beautiful light oak flooring, every element in the room was open for reimagining. This gave the designer ample creative freedom to craft a thoughtful, cohesive space. The result would be a bedroom that not only looks beautiful but also supports relaxation and everyday comfort—an ideal sanctuary for unwinding.

They were especially drawn to large bedrooms that combined structure with softness. The chosen designs contained no loud excess pieces eating up floor space. Just carefully chosen relaxing paint colors for bedroom walls, paired with woven surfaces and art that doesn’t try too hard. Similarly, natural textures and elegant furniture lines weren’t just for show; they solved things.

Results Revealed: Relaxing Bedroom Design

The final layout delivers a controlled calm. Every object in the room serves a clear purpose—nothing drifts, nothing clutters. The bed sits low, drawing the eye horizontally rather than vertically, which is critical in a room with exposed beams overhead. Sconces replace table lamps, reducing surface noise and freeing up space on the nightstands. As the client wanted, the palette holds close to relaxing bedroom decor principles: muted browns, off-whites, and softened grays. Visually, the shift from the original space to the new one is drastic. Yet, it’s not due to large interventions but because of tactical restraint. The old room had too much contrast with too little direction—dark ceiling beams, a glass coffee table, and an isolated fireplace column against bare walls. Nothing anchored the setup. Now, on the other hand, balance and flow dominate the relaxing bedroom design.

The rug defines the sleeping area and softens the transition between the low bed and the pale floor. Two ottomans in front of the fireplace continue its story in the same style. By using a flat, textural weave instead of a deep pile or pattern, the designer maintained a clean visual plane and a lightweight mood.

Initial Concepts: Finding the Right Designer

Once the brief was in, Minnaro matched the client with two professionals—Sharné L. and Esra S. Each designer boasted a consistent record of translating minimal input into focused, livable interiors. The contrast between their moodboards was subtle but meaningful, giving the client two compelling directions for the relaxing bedroom design.

Esra leaned into soft symmetry and a slightly more formal tone. Her proposal paired sculptural lines with warm neutrals and crisp lighting, shaping a space that felt composed and grown-up. In contrast, Sharné’s vision was quieter in mood but richer in atmosphere.

“Working with Minnaro was a dream. They listened to our vision and turned our home into a sanctuary with flawless details and thoughtful design. We get compliments every time someone visits!"

kate Millor Tweet

Blending Function with Style

The absence of excessive styling is noticeable. Plants are minimal, bookshelves are not overfilled with relaxing room decor. In addition, the present decorative objects are kept geometric and low-gloss. The room isn’t trying to suggest a lifestyle; it’s built to support it. What the designer achieved here is a quiet, functioning system disguised as a bedroom. And that’s what makes it work. Throughout the process, Sharné provided alternate directions and ideas for the client to consider. One proposal leaned more tonal. Another brought in different light fixtures and a stronger contrast. These variations refined the client’s sense of what a relaxing bedroom design meant to them personally as much as stylistically.
